description: Region defaults for Bosch ME7.x firmware checksum/CRC layout. Values are CONFIG defaults from me7sum.c (lines 162-181); per-variant addresses are mostly resolved at runtime by ME7Sum's scanners (multipoint table walk + needle search). Variant-specific defaults below are anchored from the 512KB fallback in me7sum.c (line 2168-2173) and the multipoint-table scan window (line 2623).

epk_secondary_signature.note: Fallback EPK marker when needle-based scan fails (me7sum.c FindEPK, line 1091-1101). 6 bytes; EPK string starts at FFFE+6 = 0x10004.

ME7.1.notes: Default ME7.1 512KB layout. Per sample.ini and me7sum.c lines 162-181 + 2168-2173.

ME7.1.1.notes: Same family as ME7.1; multipoint table located by scanner at runtime.

ME7.5.notes: ME7.5 variant; same scanner-driven discovery as ME7.1.
